papers.title: Efficient Streaming Audio-Visual Target Speaker Extraction for Real-World Acoustic Scenes
papers.brief: 研究发布覆盖复杂声学干扰的RealSSA基准，并提出因果模型Falcon。模型以单次编解码完成多尺度时频分离，结合编码空间说话人对比损失抑制串音。
papers.tldr: 通过真实场景基准与轻量因果模型，兼顾流式视听目标说话人提取的质量和效率。
papers.what_it_is: 研究发布覆盖复杂声学干扰的RealSSA基准，并提出因果模型Falcon。模型以单次编解码完成多尺度时频分离，结合编码空间说话人对比损失抑制串音。
key_points: RealSSA含真实录音评测，模拟1—5名近场及10—15名远场干扰者
Falcon单次分离，编码空间对比损失不增加推理开销
较因果AV-TFGridNet参数减91.9%，GPU推理提速11.1倍
papers.why_notable: 同时补齐复杂声学评测与轻量流式建模两环，在四个基准取得领先提取质量，为低延迟边缘部署提供更有力依据。
papers.abstract: Streaming audio-visual target speaker extraction (AVTSE) is essential for latency-sensitive applications. However, current causal systems face two coupled gaps. First, standard benchmarks fix the number of speakers at two and ignore the near-/far-field interference, reverberation, and sudden noise of real scenes. Second, high-performance causal architectures are too heavy for edge deployment. Lightweight alternatives try to reclaim capacity by repeatedly invoking a small separator, which offsets the savings. To address the first gap, we release RealSSA, a realistic AVTSE benchmark consisting of RealSSA-Sim and RealSSA-Real. RealSSA-Sim provides controllable simulated scenes with 1--5 dynamic near-field interfering speakers; scenes with far-field interference additionally include 10--15 far-field interfering speakers. RealSSA-Real provides a held-out real-recorded evaluation set. To address the second gap, we propose Falcon, a causal AVTSE method. Its Separator performs multi-scale time-frequency separation in a single encoder--decoder pass. We train Falcon with an encoder-space speaker contrastive loss. This loss suppresses near-field leakage at zero inference cost and transfers across backbones. Falcon achieves state-of-the-art extraction quality on RealSSA-Sim, LRS2-2Mix, LRS3-2Mix, and VoxCeleb2-2Mix. Compared with the causal AV-TFGridNet baseline, it cuts parameters by 91.9%, computation by 20.2 times, and GPU inference latency by 11.1 times. Code and demo are available at https://cslikai.cn/Falcon/.

papers.title: TAO: Tool-Aware Joint Scheduling for LLM-Based Agentic Serving
papers.brief: TAO面向交替调用GPU模型与CPU工具的智能体服务，将工具就绪时间、衰减缓存收益和词元占用纳入价值评估，再用动态规划联合决定会话准入与节点放置。
papers.tldr: 结合工具返回时机与缓存价值，联合调度智能体会话以降低延迟、提高吞吐。
papers.what_it_is: TAO面向交替调用GPU模型与CPU工具的智能体服务，将工具就绪时间、衰减缓存收益和词元占用纳入价值评估，再用动态规划联合决定会话准入与节点放置。
key_points: 价值接口融合工具就绪、节点缓存衰减与词元占用
动态规划在容量约束下联合选择和放置等待会话
12组设置中延迟最多降26.8%，吞吐增29.5%
papers.why_notable: 将工具执行状态直接纳入GPU资源调度，减少跨阶段资源浪费；相对各指标最佳基线，首词元时间最多降低36.3%。
papers.abstract: Agentic services alternate between model inference on clustered GPUs and external tools on distributed CPUs. In this scenario, existing systems (1) overlook tool-return readiness in service evaluation, wasting limited resources, and (2) use heuristic strategies to decide admission and placement on GPUs, resulting in suboptimal scheduling decisions. To bridge this gap, we present TAO, a tool-aware joint scheduling framework for LLM-based agentic serving. Its value interface combines near-term tool readiness, node-specific cache credit with time-aware decay, and token footprint; a dynamic program jointly selects and places waiting sessions under capacity constraints. Across the 12 reported model-workload-concurrency settings, TAO reduces latency by up to 26.8%, reduces mean time to first token (TTFT) by up to 36.3%, and increases decode throughput by up to 29.5% relative to the best evaluated state-of-the-art baseline for each metric.

papers.abstract: As frontier language models grow increasingly capable and autonomous, independent third-party evaluations are critical for characterizing their systemic safety risks. While closed-source releases are routinely accompanied by comprehensive system cards, open-weight models receive less scrutiny regarding frontier risks. To address this gap, we present an independent safety evaluation of DeepSeek V4.1 Flash-1017, the latest version of V4.1 Flash that departs from V4 with a new architecture, scaled-up training, and strong agentic capabilities. Drawing on the EU General-Purpose AI Code of Practice, we evaluate the model across 34 benchmarks, including 5 in-house suites, spanning evaluation integrity, loss of control, and harmful manipulation. Conforming to the AEF-1 standard, we compare V4.1 Flash-1017 against V4.1 Flash, earlier DeepSeek V4 models, and leading closed-source systems (GPT-6 Astra, GPT-5.6 Sol, and Gemini 3.8 Flash). Overall, V4.1 Flash-1017 shows substantial safety improvements over the V4 generation and approaches or matches leading closed-source baselines on several dimensions, while still exhibiting notable behaviors that warrant continued attention. Building on our findings, we highlight three key observations and recommendations. First, because safety can shift and even regress across minor updates, developers should integrate safety evaluation into incremental releases. Second, as final-turn outputs and end-state checks alone cannot reliably detect loss-of-control behaviors, deployments require process-level observability across both reasoning traces and action logs. Third, because public benchmarks elicit strong evaluation awareness and face data contamination risks, developing private benchmarks is essential for trustworthy frontier evaluation.

papers.title: Precedent or Intent? What Coding Agents Follow When Evolving Existing Code
papers.brief: 研究通过双向受控实验，分离编码智能体的默认偏好、仓库惯例与任务指令，并在开源仓库验证，考察惯例位置及显式规则如何影响实现选择。
papers.tldr: 编码智能体倾向沿用仓库惯例，而显式优先级规则能有效引导其遵循新意图。
papers.what_it_is: 研究通过双向受控实验，分离编码智能体的默认偏好、仓库惯例与任务指令，并在开源仓库验证，考察惯例位置及显式规则如何影响实现选择。
key_points: 5625次试验覆盖4种编码智能体、6组实现方案。
3个本地文件示例带来96%采纳率，同级资源文件仅4%。
开源仓库中，测试框架加载规则将联合成功数从0/120提升至117/120。
papers.why_notable: 结果揭示代码示例的影响取决于位置，而非仅数量；显式记录设计理由与优先级，可帮助智能体在维护旧代码时正确执行新需求。
papers.abstract: Existing code reveals past implementation decisions but rarely explains the reasoning behind them. When coding agents implement new features or modify existing functionality, past decisions may conflict with new task instructions. This raises a fundamental question for agentic software evolution: when multiple implementations satisfy the same functional requirements, how do coding agents decide whether to follow existing code or new task instructions? We investigate this question through bidirectional, controlled experiments in purpose-built repositories, followed by validation in real-world open-source repositories. Our approach isolates three competing sources of guidance: (1) agents' default preferences, (2) repository precedents, and (3) explicit task instructions. We conduct 5,625 trials across four coding agents and six implementation pairs, with validation in four open-source repositories spanning three programming languages. We find that agents share the same default implementation choices, yet overwhelmingly follow repository precedent when it conflicts with those defaults (359/360 trials). Crucially, not all precedents carry equal influence: three supporting local files yield 96% adoption, compared with only 4% for sibling-resource files, and changing file placement alone can shift adoption from 0% to 100% at a fixed example count. When new task intent conflicts with existing code, written priority rules achieve substantially higher success than code examples alone (59/60 versus 38/60 joint successes for two agents on two implementation pairs). The effectiveness of explicit rules also extends to open-source repositories, where a harness-loaded rule raises joint success from 0/120 to 117/120. These findings motivate design-decision traceability that preserves not only implementation choices but also the rationale and priorities that should guide future changes.

papers.title: Rubricon: Automated Rubric Generation and Refinement for LLM Evaluation and Training
papers.brief: Rubricon用大模型采样多套评分准则，筛选区分度最高者，再增补遗漏要求、删除偏离或浅显条目。结合自我批评与条目通过率指导迭代，无需人工偏好标签或训练生成器。
papers.tldr: 自动生成并迭代优化评分准则，无需人工标注即可提升模型评估与训练效果。
papers.what_it_is: Rubricon用大模型采样多套评分准则，筛选区分度最高者，再增补遗漏要求、删除偏离或浅显条目。结合自我批评与条目通过率指导迭代，无需人工偏好标签或训练生成器。
key_points: 结合LLM自我批评与条目通过率增删评分标准

HealthBench后训练较RRD准则提升4.5%
papers.why_notable: 为缺乏可验证答案的任务提供低人工成本的奖励设计路径，且优势同时体现在专家评分对齐和模型后训练效果上。
papers.abstract: Rubrics enable reward assignment on tasks without verifiable answers, but are expensive to manually produce from scratch. We present Rubricon, a pipeline that generates discriminative rubrics without requiring human preference labels, rubric annotation, or generator-model training. Using any LLM, Rubricon samples multiple rubrics, selects the most discriminative candidate, adds criteria to capture overlooked requirements or response flaws, and prunes criteria that are misaligned or shallow. Alongside LLM self-critique and test-time scaling, Rubricon uses observed criterion pass rates on example model responses to guide refinement. Across five professional, consumer, clinical, and general-use LLM benchmarks, Rubricon produces rubrics whose scores of frontier LLM responses exhibit 9% greater alignment with labor-intensive expert-authored rubrics, compared to the best alternative synthetic rubric generation method among RRD, QSRG, OpenRubrics, and agentic generation via harnesses like Codex. On HealthBench, post-training a Qwen3.5-9B model with Rubricon rubrics yields 4.5% better performance than training with rubrics from the strongest alternative synthetic rubric generator, RRD.

papers.brief: 该方法从多张参考图重建主体表面法线，以转台式法线图作为视频生成条件，无需逐帧时间对齐；同时自动合成几何一致的多轨迹训练视频。

papers.what_it_is: 该方法从多张参考图重建主体表面法线，以转台式法线图作为视频生成条件，无需逐帧时间对齐；同时自动合成几何一致的多轨迹训练视频。

papers.abstract: Generating videos of a specific subject from a few reference images remains challenging when the camera reveals surfaces that are not visible in the input. Early subject-to-video (S2V) methods condition on a single reference image and must therefore infer the subject's unseen appearance and geometry as the viewpoint changes. To address this limitation, recent methods extend S2V to multiple reference views, providing more information about the subject from different viewpoints. However, they do not explicitly specify the 3D structure that connects these observations. In addition, existing training data do not guarantee that viewpoint changes preserve the same underlying 3D subject. We present OmniShowcase, built on two components: (i) a fully automated data synthesis pipeline that produces training videos along diverse camera trajectories, with viewpoint variation driven by underlying subject geometry, even spanning full 360-degree orbits; and (ii) a geometry-conditioning method that provides the video model with a turntable of surface-normal maps reconstructed from the reference views without requiring temporal alignment with the generated frames. We construct Showcase-4K, a corpus of 3D-asset-based videos covering twelve camera motions across 88 trajectory configurations with reconstruction-derived surface-normal conditioning, and ShowcaseBench, a held-out evaluation set with the source meshes and camera parameters used to render each video. Experiments show state-of-the-art subject identity and 3D consistency while maintaining competitive video quality and motion. Project page: justin4ai.github.io/OmniShowcase

papers.abstract: Many Indian banks serve customers through FAQ pages and scripted chatbots. Assistants based on language models could respond faster and carry out requests such as blocking a card, but only if they give correct information and follow the bank's rules. These rules prescribe a procedure, a set of required steps, such as obtaining a closure quote before closing a deposit. Adapting models to this domain requires measuring how well they follow the procedure, before and after training. Benchmarks usually judge only the records left at the end of a conversation. Many required steps, however, leave the records unchanged, so an assistant that skips them can still be judged successful. We present TauIndianBankBench, an action-oriented benchmark of 1,000 Indian retail-banking tasks where an assistant helps a simulated customer. Besides the final records, it checks that the assistant took every required step and made no unrequested change. For every model, 6.5-12.0% of sessions are judged successful when only the final records are checked, although the assistant skipped a required step or made an unrequested change. Scoring both procedure and outcome shows more accurately how well language models perform in Indian retail banking.

papers.title: RealCLI: Toward a Unified Evaluation of Human-Agent Collaboration for CLI Agents
papers.brief: 提出统一衡量命令行任务执行与人机协作质量的配对基准：一组预先给出完整要求，另一组由脚本用户逐步补充信息、纠正指令并调整约束与授权。
papers.tldr: REALCLI以配对任务评测命令行智能体，揭示任务执行与人机协作的明显落差。
papers.what_it_is: 提出统一衡量命令行任务执行与人机协作质量的配对基准：一组预先给出完整要求，另一组由脚本用户逐步补充信息、纠正指令并调整约束与授权。
key_points: 协作框架覆盖5个维度、22个子维度和51类交互模板
REALCLI-EXEC与REALCLI-COLLAB支持配对比较

papers.why_notable: 将动态用户交互纳入可复现评测，避免仅以任务完成衡量能力；结果暴露智能体在可引导性、信任校准和安全边界管理上的短板。
papers.abstract: Command-line interface (CLI) agents increasingly execute longer-horizon tasks, yet existing benchmarks either assume that user instructions remain fixed throughout execution or evaluate task outcomes without capturing runtime collaboration quality. In this paper, we present REALCLI, a paired benchmark that unifies the evaluation of task execution and human-agent collaboration quality on realistic CLI tasks. To comprehensively measure collaboration, REALCLI builds a five-dimensional framework, operationalized into 22 sub-dimensions and 51 interaction scenario templates. REALCLI provides two modes for paired comparison: REALCLI-EXEC supplies complete specifications upfront, whereas REALCLI-COLLAB introduces a scripted user that delivers progressive information, corrections, constraint revisions, and authorization decisions. Evaluations reveal profound capability gaps in frontier agents: the best configuration attains an average score of only 49.2%, and when evaluated by the joint collaboration score ($J_{\mathrm{collab}}$), the peak performance reaches merely 37.6%. These results show that task effectiveness diverges sharply from collaboration quality, with models consistently struggling in steerability, trust calibration, and safety boundary management. REALCLI provides a rigorous, reproducible foundation for measuring and advancing collaborative CLI agents.

papers.title: Amortizing Sequential Experimental Design in Reasoning LLMs
papers.brief: 将序贯贝叶斯实验设计摊销到大模型策略中，用信息增益奖励训练指导行动选择的推理。实验生成模型独立于模型自身信念，使信息采集目标可按指定模型优化。
papers.tldr: 用信息增益奖励训练大模型提问推理，以更低计算成本学习可迁移的信息采集策略。
papers.what_it_is: 将序贯贝叶斯实验设计摊销到大模型策略中，用信息增益奖励训练指导行动选择的推理。实验生成模型独立于模型自身信念，使信息采集目标可按指定模型优化。
key_points: 以信息增益奖励训练行动选择推理，摊销序贯BED

papers.abstract: Despite their extensive pretraining knowledge and strong reasoning capabilities, large language models (LLMs) struggle to adaptively gather information in experimental design tasks. We study how to amortize sequential Bayesian experimental design (BED) into an LLM by explicitly training the reasoning that guides action selection using information-gain rewards. Our approach specifies the experimental generative model independently of the LLM's own beliefs, allowing us to optimize expected information gain under a model of our choosing. We investigate the design choices for amortization, including alternative generative-model constructions, reward estimation, hypothesis-space specification, multi-step objectives, and computational costs relative to training- and inference-time BED baselines. On Twenty Questions, the resulting policies improve information acquisition and task performance, outperform inference- and training-time BED baselines at substantially lower computational cost, and generalize to unseen categories. We further demonstrate positive transfer from Twenty Questions training to Medi-Q, a real-world clinical dialogue benchmark. These results suggest that information gathering can be learned as a generalizable reasoning skill in LLMs.

papers.title: HuGe: Scaling Humanoid Generalist Vision-Language-Action Models with Egocentric Experience
papers.brief: HuGe用逾2000小时人类与机器人第一视角数据预训练人形VLA，通过三阶段训练预测全身控制器的潜在运动词元和手部信号，并适配跨具身差异。
papers.tldr: 融合第一视角人类经验与机器人数据，提升人形机器人全身控制与任务泛化
papers.what_it_is: HuGe用逾2000小时人类与机器人第一视角数据预训练人形VLA，通过三阶段训练预测全身控制器的潜在运动词元和手部信号，并适配跨具身差异。
key_points: 采用三种VLA架构，预测潜在运动词元与手部控制信号
仿真回放构造伪本体感知状态，重渲染适配手臂外观
HumanoidArena达最优，Unitree G1抓放成功率显著提高
papers.why_notable: 将规模化人类经验用于人形机器人，缓解昂贵示范采集的压力；仿真与真机结果支持视觉适配和伪本体感知的迁移价值。
papers.abstract: Extending Vision-Language-Action models (VLAs) to humanoid robots requires coordinated whole-body control and diverse demonstrations that are costly to collect in real-world scenarios. Although egocentric human demonstrations provide a complementary source of task experience, differences in visual embodiment and missing robot proprioception complicate transfer to humanoid policies. To address these challenges, we introduce HuGe, a family of Humanoid Generalist VLAs pre-trained on over 2,000 hours of egocentric human and robot data. Specifically, HuGe employs three existing representative VLA architectures to predict latent motion tokens for a pretrained whole-body controller, together with hand-control signals. Based on this, we introduce a three-stage training pipeline that combines egocentric pre-training, humanoid adaptation, and downstream fine-tuning. To facilitate transfer across embodiments, we construct pseudo-proprioceptive states through simulation playback during pre-training and modify arm appearance in egocentric observations through re-rendering during downstream fine-tuning. With this pipeline, HuGe achieves the state-of-the-art on simulation benchmark HumanoidArena. Furthermore, real-world experiments on the Unitree G1 indicate that augmenting robot demonstrations with visually adapted egocentric demonstrations significantly increases success on a pick-and-drop task.

papers.title: CausGround: Causal Interaction Grounding for Adaptive Embodied Planning
papers.brief: CausGround将交互经验提炼为动作前提与效果，并用对象属性和关系组织世界状态。规划时结合当前观测，反推执行条件、前推动作后果。
papers.tldr: 将交互经验转为可复用因果知识，无需更新参数即可提升具身多步规划成功率。
papers.what_it_is: CausGround将交互经验提炼为动作前提与效果，并用对象属性和关系组织世界状态。规划时结合当前观测，反推执行条件、前推动作后果。

VirtualHome成功率由24.9%升至53.3%
